title: Kunemlilo Entsabeni
description: Thuli nebangani bakhe bayatsandza kudlala batsi “Kunemlilo Entsabeni”. Kepha kwenteka-ke ngalinye lilanga yasha mbamba futsi tonkhe titjalo letinhle entsabeni tasha taba ngumlotsa. Thuli nebangani bakhe balusizi … kwate kwaba ngulapho babona emahlumela lamancane labovu nalaluhlata. Yini loku?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
